jobs.title: Senior Digital Project Manager (Shopify)
jobs.description:
Perceptiv Digital is a Shopify Premier agency for mid-market Australian retailers turning over $5M to $50M a year. More than 200 projects delivered. Official partner status with Shopify, Google, Klaviyo and Neto/Maropost.

We're hiring one senior person to own the client side of delivery. The portfolio already exists and it's waiting for you. This isn't a role you build into over a year.

What you will actually do

A portfolio of retained ecommerce clients and active builds becomes yours end to end. You scope it, run it, keep it profitable, and sit across the table from the owners of the businesses we grow.

You direct the work. Our Project Lead runs the developers. Because the dev team works in a different time zone, your morning starts by reviewing what landed overnight, and their morning starts with your priorities. Clients see progress every single day.

You will own

A portfolio of Shopify Plus clients and active build projects, from scope through launch and beyond
The weekly client WIPs, the briefs, and the hard conversations about scope and hours
The daily handoff that keeps the dev board full
Retainer burn, milestone billing and invoicing triggers, tracked through the month rather than at the end of it
Scoping and estimates for new business, without carrying a sales target
Working relationships across the Shopify, Klaviyo and integration vendor ecosystem

What we need from you

Five or more years in agency delivery, digital production, or a blended account and project management role
Hands on Shopify or Shopify Plus delivery experience. You have run real builds on the platform
Ecommerce fluency. You can talk conversion rate, AOV and trading numbers with a retailer, not just timelines
A track record running several concurrent clients without dropping balls
Comfort owning budgets, hours and commercial conversations
Experience working with distributed development teams across time zones
Australian citizen who resides in Australia (Perth preferred)

Replatform experience, integration exposure (MYOB, CIN7, NetSuite, Mirakl) and ClickUp are all a bonus.

What this role is not

Not a scrum master. Not a ticket shuffler. Not an account manager with no technical depth. And not an operations role, so you will not own HR, finance or internal systems.

What you get

No layers. You report to the founder and decisions take a conversation, not a committee
A real portfolio from day one, with established clients and genuine authority over how their work runs
A delivery bonus tied to results you directly influence
Genuine flexibility. Remote, distributed, output over attendance
Variety. Builds, replatforms, integrations and retainers, plus a front row seat on our ecommerce app products

How to apply

Apply here, or email igor@perceptiv.digital with your CV and a short note on one client you turned around or one project you rescued. That story tells us more than any cover letter.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Professional Services
jobs.description:
About The Team

Rubrik Professional Services transforms possibilities into outcomes. Our portfolio of services uncovers and exploits the unique opportunities made possible by Rubrik technology. Drawing on our unparalleled product expertise and customer experiences, we collaborate with customers to identify and address complex technical challenges, improve operational efficiency, and maximize their investment in Rubrik.

We are 100% focused on customer success, operational excellence, and empowering our team members to grow, lead, and innovate.

About The Role

Rubrik Professional Services is looking for a high-energy, strategic, and results-driven Senior Project Manager
to lead complex, enterprise customer implementations and help shape the future of our delivery practice. In this role, you will be customer-facing, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure deployment success, business value realization, and operational efficiency.

Beyond managing high-stakes client engagements, you will serve as an expert in project management within the organization helping to mentor and coach other Project Managers and actively contributing to the development, refinement, and scaling of our PMO governance model, processes, and delivery frameworks.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Project Manager in our PS Organization, you will drive impact across three core areas: Delivery Excellence, Leadership & Mentorship, and Practice Enablement.

Project & Client Delivery Excellence
Drive Complex Engagements: Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, concurrent, enterprise-level customer projects from kickoff to sign-off within fast-paced environments.
Scope & Milestone Management: Prepare enterprise customers for deployment, establish clear success criteria, track deliverables, set targets, manage resources, and ensure project execution adheres to deadlines and budgets.
Risk & Issue Governance: Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks and technical dependencies.
Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the single point of contact and escalation owner for customer executives, cross-functional internal teams (Engineering, Customer Support, Sales, Technical Account Managers), and third-party partners.
Quality & Performance: Execute quality control throughout project lifecycles to ensure deliverables meet or exceed Rubrik's standards and customer business objectives.
PMO Governance & Process Optimization
PMO Governance: Partner with PS leadership to help build, refine, and maintain the PMO governance framework, including standard operating procedures, project methodologies, and key performance indicators.
Continuous Improvement: Audit project workflows and delivery tools to identify bottlenecks, driving initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, margins, and customer satisfaction.
Resource & Capacity Planning: Assist in establishing best practices for resource allocation, utilization tracking, and project health reporting across the PS portfolio.
Leadership & Mentorship
Coach & Mentor: Serve as a mentor to associate and mid-level PMs, providing guidance on client management, conflict resolution, scope control, and career growth.
Thought Leadership: Share best practices, templates, and lessons learned across the team to foster a culture of continuous learning and high performance.

Required Qualifications

Experience & Qualifications you'll need

8+ years of direct Project Management experience delivering customer-facing, enterprise technical projects within a Professional Services or Consulting organization.
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification
Proven experience building or scaling PMO governance models supported by AI, standard delivery methodologies, and project health tracking processes.
Track record of managing multiple complex, high-visibility client engagements concurrently in a fast-paced technology environment.
Demonstrated experience mentoring, coaching, and developing junior to mid-level project managers.
Expert knowledge of modern project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, Asana) as well as Google Workspace.
Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.

Preferred / Plus Qualifications

Technical Background: Prior hands-on experience or foundational knowledge in Data Management, Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), Data Protection, Enterprise Storage, Cybersecurity, or SaaS delivery is a strong plus.
Additional certifications such as Agile/Scrum (CSM, PMI-ACP), ITIL, or Prosci Change Management.
Strong financial acumen regarding professional services metrics (e.g., revenue recognition, margin, utilization, project profitability).

jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Staff Technical Project Manager based in India.

This is a senior technical leadership role focused on delivering global SAP ERP capabilities across supply chain and manufacturing operations.

You will own and evolve critical Plan-to-Produce and/or Source-to-Pay process models, ensuring consistent solutions across complex ERP environments.

The role combines product ownership, project management, solution architecture, and business transformation.

You will lead SAP MM/PP design, configuration, migrations, integrations, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Working with global business, technology, and partner teams, you will translate strategic objectives into scalable technical roadmaps.

The position offers significant influence over enterprise architecture, operational efficiency, and digital transformation across multinational environments.

You will also mentor technical teams and help shape long-term ERP strategy and governance.

Accountabilities

Own the global Plan-to-Produce and/or Source-to-Pay process models and drive digital transformation initiatives across SAP Materials Management and Production Planning.
Design, configure, maintain, and optimize SAP MM/PP capabilities, including MRP, BOM management, capacity planning, inventory management, and related modules.
Lead ERP migration initiatives from legacy platforms and custom solutions into the strategic SAP environment, overseeing planning, design, execution, and deployment.
Analyze technical architecture, research new capabilities, and design integrations and functionalities within the broader SAP ecosystem.
Provide technical and architectural guidance to development teams, ensuring alignment with global standards, SAP solution extensions, and established best practices.
Protect application and solution integrity by promoting reusable technical components and preventing redundant or siloed developments.
Contribute to global ERP product strategy and roadmap definition, prioritizing initiatives based on business value and operational needs.
Partner with senior business and technology stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions and communicate project progress, risks, and decisions.
Build strong relationships across Plan-to-Produce and Source-to-Pay Centers of Excellence and other global functions.
Mentor junior team members and provide technical leadership and guidance to the global SAP Product Council.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Significant professional IT experience with established leadership credentials across SAP ERP product lines.
Deep, hands-on expertise in SAP MM or PP, with knowledge of related areas such as WM/EWM, Shop Floor Control, or Quality Management.
Experience delivering at least five full-lifecycle SAP ERP implementations, covering planning, analysis, design, build, testing, and deployment.
Strong knowledge of Procurement-to-Pay and/or Plan-to-Produce processes, including integration with SAP FICO and Project Systems.
Experience with global SAP configuration and highly integrated, multi-site ERP architectures.
Proven ability to work with executive-level stakeholders, define technology strategies, and manage complex project portfolios.
Strong business and technical problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business challenges into actionable technology roadmaps.
Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, communication, and influencing capabilities across cross-functional and international teams.
Knowledge of emerging manufacturing and supply chain technologies and their integration with SAP.
Change-oriented mindset with a track record of driving process improvements in complex, multinational environments.
Strong customer focus and ability to evaluate architectural decisions based on operational efficiency, long-term value, and business outcomes.
Ability to collaborate effectively across cultures, build consensus, and maintain momentum through complex project challenges.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity in India, with locations including Hyderabad and Bengaluru.
Opportunity to lead global SAP transformation initiatives with significant enterprise-wide impact.
Exposure to complex manufacturing, procurement, supply chain, and ERP environments.
Senior-level visibility and collaboration with executive stakeholders and global technology and business teams.
Opportunities to influence global ERP strategy, architecture, product roadmaps, and continuous improvement.
Technical leadership and mentoring opportunities within a global SAP ecosystem.
Relocation assistance is not provided.

jobs.description:
About the Company

At Future Secure AI, we're building something genuinely new — and we're looking for people bold enough to build it with us. We work at the frontier of AI, tackling big, real-world problems for global enterprises across multiple industries, armed with state-of-the-art technology and a culture that prizes courage, rigor, and relentless curiosity. Our BRAVER values aren't just words on a wall — they describe the kind of people we are and the standard we hold ourselves to every day. Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you.
About the Role

The purpose of this role is to orchestrate delivery across multiple production line pods on one or more customer accounts, aligning dependencies, timelines and priorities to keep a shared program on track. Acting as a Way of Working coach at scale, the Delivery Program Manager drives consistent practices, surfaces cross-use case risks, and removes systemic impediments so milestone commitments are met across every use case.  
Key Responsibilities

  You will be responsible for specific tasks and outcomes, including but not limited to:  
Planning & Release Management

Own the Cross-Use Case Release Plan for the production line(s): one living plan, updated weekly, with each use case's Design Review, Build, UAT and go-live and all dependencies on a single timeline.  

Sequence releases across a multi-quarter horizon spanning every use case on the account, including those not yet scoped, through to Hypercare.  

Delivery Accountability, RAID & Escalation

Own the production line-wide RAID picture, maintaining the risk register and Dependency Log across every active use case and driving resolution to closure.  

Be the point of contact for use case team challenges, receive escalations from Build Leads and Engagement Leads, and escalate to the APAC Delivery Leader where required.  

Dependency & Capacity Management

Spot where use cases compete for the same resource, platform support, customer attention or milestone; coach pods to resolve, and escalate unresolved conflicts to the Engagement Lead and Build Lead with impact and a priority recommendation.  

Own Capacity Mapping: a live view of who is allocated where and at what percentage across every use case, flagging over-allocation before a pod misses a commitment, with the Resource Manager and Operations Lead.  

Quality, Metrics & Reporting

Monitor Jira quality metrics per use case (defect rate, UAT pass rate, test coverage, production incidents), raising issues early when AI Co-Worker quality may be at risk.  

Produce one consistent read on account delivery health (milestones, dependencies, capacity, quality) for the Build Lead, Engagement Lead and AI Engineering Lead.  

Ceremonies, Coaching & Way of Working

Own the cross-use case ceremony set (weekly Scrum of Scrums, Sprint Health Reviews, Cross-Use Case Retrospectives with the Build Lead, and the Monthly Portfolio Review), observing pod ceremonies on rotation to coach.  

Foster the FSAI Way of Working, delivery standards, Jira hygiene and a solution-first mindset across pods, carrying what works in one pod across to the others.  

Authority, Tools & Environments

Hold named build-RACI accountability (Accountable for Build Readiness, Responsible for Platform Deployment Coordination) and own prioritization and sequencing when use cases compete.  

Own the subscription's artefacts (Release Plan, Capacity Map, Quality Scorecard, Dependency Log, Portfolio Hypercare Report), set up Jira and pod access, and coordinate UAT environments and the cross-use case go-live checklist.  

Relationships

Internal: Manage up and out to delivery leadership, Engagement Leads and Executive Directors; hold a trusted partnership with the Engagement Lead and flag resourcing risk early enough to act with the customer.  

External: Represent delivery health to customer sponsors and stakeholders, keeping the relationship focused on the account.  

  Key Requirements:

Demonstrated experience coordinating delivery across multiple concurrent Agile teams, ideally in a scaled or program environment  
Strong Agile delivery background (Scrum Master, RTE or Delivery Lead) with a record of coaching teams to predictable velocity  

Proven ability to own release planning, cross-team dependency management and portfolio capacity planning  

Able to hold accountability and influence without direct line authority, across peers, leads and executives  

Confident managing up and out to senior stakeholders, sponsors and program governance  

Advanced user of Jira and Confluence, with strong reporting and delivery-tooling hygiene  

A systems thinker who operates one level up, spotting cross-use case patterns before they surprise the account; AI, software or technology delivery experience preferred  

About Future Secure AI

  Future Secure AI is a tech startup that is jointly developed with one of the world's largest financial institutions.  Operating as an agile startup with deep relationships at C-suite with large global enterprises, we believe humans and AI Co-Workers will work together and give everyone the ability to get 10x performance. We are growing (rapidly) and we our people form the heart and soul of our business. Join us on the journey of transforming the world of work with the most leading edge AI.  
Our Purpose

  We believe humans and AI Co-Workers will work together and give everyone the ability to get 10x performance.  
Our Values

Customer-first  

We win customers through exceptional service, products and experiences.  
Human-forward  

We are empathetic and celebrate connecting teams and ideas through diversity and inclusion.
Unstoppable   

We are deeply devoted and relentless at innovating and unlocking world-class AI-enabled solutions.  

Disclaimer:
We do not wish to be contacted by recruitment agencies. Our hiring process is managed in-house and the best way for candidates to express interest is by applying with your resume through our company website.
Future Secure AI Privacy Policy At Future Secure AI, we are committed to protecting your privacy and adhering to the principles of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs) under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth). Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal data when you visit our website at   www.futuresecure.ai   (the "Website") and use our services.

jobs.title: Program Manager- Homelessness, Mental Health & AOD
jobs.description:
Lead. Inspire. Make a difference.

CatholicCare is growing, and this is an exciting opportunity to join our Homelessness service at an important time in its development.

We’re looking for a Program Manager who brings strong knowledge of homelessness, mental health and AOD, a passion for quality practice and the ability to support and inspire a team of Caseworkers, providing practice leadership, supervision and mentoring while helping shape a strong, connected and outcomes-focused service.

This is more than a team leadership role. It’s an opportunity to influence practice, build capability and help strengthen the way we support people experiencing homelessness and mental health challenges.

This is a permanent full-time role based in Hornsby and requires the incumbent to be office based for the first 6 months. After successful completion of the probation period, there will be an option to work from home.

About The Role

As a Program Manager, you’ll provide day-to-day practice leadership to a team supporting individuals and families experiencing homelessness and housing instability, often facing intersecting challenges including mental health, alcohol and other drug (AOD) issues, family violence, and other complex needs.

You’ll bring your specialist knowledge to complex situations, helping the team develop practical, person-centered responses that build stability, safety and wellbeing.

You will work closely alongside other Program Managers within our Homelessness portfolio. Through collaboration, shared leadership and a commitment to continuous improvement, you will contribute to the development of best practice approaches that support high-quality service delivery for people experiencing homelessness and complex, intersecting needs.

Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, you’ll help connect people with the right services and strengthen pathways across the homelessness, mental health and community services sectors. You’ll also play an important role in building a positive team culture where Caseworkers feel supported, challenged and confident in their practice.

What You’ll Do

Lead, supervise and mentor a team of 7 Caseworkers, including providing clinical/practice supervision.
Lead the day-to-day operations of our drop-in centre, supporting high-quality service delivery, positive client outcomes, continuous improvement and a safe, inclusive environment for all visitors.
Provide specialist guidance and support around complex homelessness and mental health presentations.
Support the team to deliver high-quality, trauma-informed and strengths-based casework.
Work alongside Caseworkers to develop practical interventions that improve housing stability, wellbeing and client outcomes.
Build strong referral pathways and relationships across homelessness, mental health, health and community services.
Develop and maintain effective partnerships with government and non-government organisations.
Support the team with risk assessment, crisis response and complex decision-making.
Promote reflective practice, professional development and continuous improvement.
Ensure practice aligns with program requirements and the Human Services Outcomes Framework.
Monitor and report on outcomes to ensure the service is achieving meaningful results.
Foster a positive, collaborative and high-performing team culture.

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for someone who combines strong people leadership with genuine specialist knowledge of homelessness and mental health.

Tertiary qualifications in Social Work, Psychology, Counselling or a related discipline.
Experience leading, supervising or providing practice/clinical leadership to a team.
Strong knowledge and practical experience working within the homelessness and/or mental health sectors.
Experience supporting people experiencing complex and intersecting challenges.
A strong understanding of trauma-informed, strengths-based and person-centred practice.
Confidence working with complex risk, crisis situations and challenging presentations.
Strong assessment, problem-solving and professional decision-making skills.
The ability to build trusted relationships with clients, colleagues and external stakeholders.
Strong networking, advocacy and partnership-building skills.
A genuine commitment to improving outcomes for people experiencing homelessness and mental health challenges.

Why CatholicCare?

This is an exciting time to join CatholicCare.

We’re a growing service with strong leadership, a supportive team environment and a genuine focus on making a difference.

As a Program Manager, you’ll have the support and opportunity to make your mark: developing your team, influencing practice and contributing to the continued growth of our Homelessness service.

You’ll Also Have Access To

Not-for-profit salary packaging - increase your take-home pay by packaging a portion of your salary tax-free.
Regular reflective and practice supervision.
Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
Employee Assistance Program providing free and confidential counselling and support.
CatholicCare Day - an additional paid leave day at the end of the year.
Flexible work arrangements.
A supportive, respectful and inclusive workplace.
Opportunities to grow your career within a growing CatholicCare service.

Ready for Your Next Opportunity?

If you’re looking for a leadership role where you can use your specialist knowledge, develop a team and help shape a growing service, we’d love to hear from you.

Bring your expertise in homelessness and mental health and join CatholicCare as we continue to grow our impact in the community.

Submit your Cover Letter and Resume outlining how your experience aligns with this role. For more information about Dom's place visit: https://catholiccaredbb.org.au/individual-family-supports/doms-place

Should you have any questions before applying, please contact recruitment@catholiccaredbb.org.au

CatholicCare is a safe, respectful and inclusive employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and can provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

No recruitment agencies.

A portfolio of retained ecommerce clients and active builds becomes yours end to end. You scope it, run it, keep it profitable, and sit across the table from the owners of the businesses we grow.

Apply here, or email igor@perceptiv.digital with your CV and a short note on one client you turned around or one project you rescued. That story tells us more than any cover letter.

new_jobs.description:
About the Company

At Future Secure AI, we're building something genuinely new — and we're looking for people bold enough to build it with us. We work at the frontier of AI, tackling big, real-world problems for global enterprises across multiple industries, armed with state-of-the-art technology and a culture that prizes courage, rigor, and relentless curiosity. Our BRAVER values aren't just words on a wall — they describe the kind of people we are and the standard we hold ourselves to every day. Our leadership team is entrepreneurial, experienced, and accessible, with an open-door policy that means you'll never be just a number here. We invest seriously in your growth because we know our success depends on yours. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry, push into uncharted territory, and do work that genuinely matters, Future Secure AI is the place for you.
About the Role

The purpose of this role is to orchestrate delivery across multiple production line pods on one or more customer accounts, aligning dependencies, timelines and priorities to keep a shared program on track. Acting as a Way of Working coach at scale, the Delivery Program Manager drives consistent practices, surfaces cross-use case risks, and removes systemic impediments so milestone commitments are met across every use case.  
Key Responsibilities

  You will be responsible for specific tasks and outcomes, including but not limited to:  
Planning & Release Management

Own the Cross-Use Case Release Plan for the production line(s): one living plan, updated weekly, with each use case's Design Review, Build, UAT and go-live and all dependencies on a single timeline.  

Sequence releases across a multi-quarter horizon spanning every use case on the account, including those not yet scoped, through to Hypercare.  

Delivery Accountability, RAID & Escalation

Own the production line-wide RAID picture, maintaining the risk register and Dependency Log across every active use case and driving resolution to closure.  

Be the point of contact for use case team challenges, receive escalations from Build Leads and Engagement Leads, and escalate to the APAC Delivery Leader where required.  

Dependency & Capacity Management

Spot where use cases compete for the same resource, platform support, customer attention or milestone; coach pods to resolve, and escalate unresolved conflicts to the Engagement Lead and Build Lead with impact and a priority recommendation.  

Own Capacity Mapping: a live view of who is allocated where and at what percentage across every use case, flagging over-allocation before a pod misses a commitment, with the Resource Manager and Operations Lead.  

Quality, Metrics & Reporting

Monitor Jira quality metrics per use case (defect rate, UAT pass rate, test coverage, production incidents), raising issues early when AI Co-Worker quality may be at risk.  

Produce one consistent read on account delivery health (milestones, dependencies, capacity, quality) for the Build Lead, Engagement Lead and AI Engineering Lead.  

Ceremonies, Coaching & Way of Working

Own the cross-use case ceremony set (weekly Scrum of Scrums, Sprint Health Reviews, Cross-Use Case Retrospectives with the Build Lead, and the Monthly Portfolio Review), observing pod ceremonies on rotation to coach.  

Foster the FSAI Way of Working, delivery standards, Jira hygiene and a solution-first mindset across pods, carrying what works in one pod across to the others.  

Authority, Tools & Environments

Hold named build-RACI accountability (Accountable for Build Readiness, Responsible for Platform Deployment Coordination) and own prioritization and sequencing when use cases compete.  

Own the subscription's artefacts (Release Plan, Capacity Map, Quality Scorecard, Dependency Log, Portfolio Hypercare Report), set up Jira and pod access, and coordinate UAT environments and the cross-use case go-live checklist.  

Relationships

Internal: Manage up and out to delivery leadership, Engagement Leads and Executive Directors; hold a trusted partnership with the Engagement Lead and flag resourcing risk early enough to act with the customer.  

External: Represent delivery health to customer sponsors and stakeholders, keeping the relationship focused on the account.  

  Key Requirements:

Demonstrated experience coordinating delivery across multiple concurrent Agile teams, ideally in a scaled or program environment  
Strong Agile delivery background (Scrum Master, RTE or Delivery Lead) with a record of coaching teams to predictable velocity  

Proven ability to own release planning, cross-team dependency management and portfolio capacity planning  

Able to hold accountability and influence without direct line authority, across peers, leads and executives  

Confident managing up and out to senior stakeholders, sponsors and program governance  

Advanced user of Jira and Confluence, with strong reporting and delivery-tooling hygiene  

A systems thinker who operates one level up, spotting cross-use case patterns before they surprise the account; AI, software or technology delivery experience preferred  

About Future Secure AI

  Future Secure AI is a tech startup that is jointly developed with one of the world's largest financial institutions.  Operating as an agile startup with deep relationships at C-suite with large global enterprises, we believe humans and AI Co-Workers will work together and give everyone the ability to get 10x performance. We are growing (rapidly) and we our people form the heart and soul of our business. Join us on the journey of transforming the world of work with the most leading edge AI.  
Our Purpose

  We believe humans and AI Co-Workers will work together and give everyone the ability to get 10x performance.  
Our Values

Customer-first  

We win customers through exceptional service, products and experiences.  
Human-forward  

We are empathetic and celebrate connecting teams and ideas through diversity and inclusion.
Unstoppable   

We are deeply devoted and relentless at innovating and unlocking world-class AI-enabled solutions.  

Disclaimer:
We do not wish to be contacted by recruitment agencies. Our hiring process is managed in-house and the best way for candidates to express interest is by applying with your resume through our company website.
Future Secure AI Privacy Policy At Future Secure AI, we are committed to protecting your privacy and adhering to the principles of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs) under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth). Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, share, and protect your personal data when you visit our website at   www.futuresecure.ai   (the "Website") and use our services.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager- Homelessness, Mental Health & AOD
new_jobs.description:
Lead. Inspire. Make a difference.

CatholicCare is growing, and this is an exciting opportunity to join our Homelessness service at an important time in its development.

We’re looking for a Program Manager who brings strong knowledge of homelessness, mental health and AOD, a passion for quality practice and the ability to support and inspire a team of Caseworkers, providing practice leadership, supervision and mentoring while helping shape a strong, connected and outcomes-focused service.

This is more than a team leadership role. It’s an opportunity to influence practice, build capability and help strengthen the way we support people experiencing homelessness and mental health challenges.

This is a permanent full-time role based in Hornsby and requires the incumbent to be office based for the first 6 months. After successful completion of the probation period, there will be an option to work from home.

About The Role

As a Program Manager, you’ll provide day-to-day practice leadership to a team supporting individuals and families experiencing homelessness and housing instability, often facing intersecting challenges including mental health, alcohol and other drug (AOD) issues, family violence, and other complex needs.

You’ll bring your specialist knowledge to complex situations, helping the team develop practical, person-centered responses that build stability, safety and wellbeing.

You will work closely alongside other Program Managers within our Homelessness portfolio. Through collaboration, shared leadership and a commitment to continuous improvement, you will contribute to the development of best practice approaches that support high-quality service delivery for people experiencing homelessness and complex, intersecting needs.

Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, you’ll help connect people with the right services and strengthen pathways across the homelessness, mental health and community services sectors. You’ll also play an important role in building a positive team culture where Caseworkers feel supported, challenged and confident in their practice.

What You’ll Do

Lead, supervise and mentor a team of 7 Caseworkers, including providing clinical/practice supervision.
Lead the day-to-day operations of our drop-in centre, supporting high-quality service delivery, positive client outcomes, continuous improvement and a safe, inclusive environment for all visitors.
Provide specialist guidance and support around complex homelessness and mental health presentations.
Support the team to deliver high-quality, trauma-informed and strengths-based casework.
Work alongside Caseworkers to develop practical interventions that improve housing stability, wellbeing and client outcomes.
Build strong referral pathways and relationships across homelessness, mental health, health and community services.
Develop and maintain effective partnerships with government and non-government organisations.
Support the team with risk assessment, crisis response and complex decision-making.
Promote reflective practice, professional development and continuous improvement.
Ensure practice aligns with program requirements and the Human Services Outcomes Framework.
Monitor and report on outcomes to ensure the service is achieving meaningful results.
Foster a positive, collaborative and high-performing team culture.

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for someone who combines strong people leadership with genuine specialist knowledge of homelessness and mental health.

Tertiary qualifications in Social Work, Psychology, Counselling or a related discipline.
Experience leading, supervising or providing practice/clinical leadership to a team.
Strong knowledge and practical experience working within the homelessness and/or mental health sectors.
Experience supporting people experiencing complex and intersecting challenges.
A strong understanding of trauma-informed, strengths-based and person-centred practice.
Confidence working with complex risk, crisis situations and challenging presentations.
Strong assessment, problem-solving and professional decision-making skills.
The ability to build trusted relationships with clients, colleagues and external stakeholders.
Strong networking, advocacy and partnership-building skills.
A genuine commitment to improving outcomes for people experiencing homelessness and mental health challenges.

Why CatholicCare?

This is an exciting time to join CatholicCare.

We’re a growing service with strong leadership, a supportive team environment and a genuine focus on making a difference.

As a Program Manager, you’ll have the support and opportunity to make your mark: developing your team, influencing practice and contributing to the continued growth of our Homelessness service.

You’ll Also Have Access To

Not-for-profit salary packaging - increase your take-home pay by packaging a portion of your salary tax-free.
Regular reflective and practice supervision.
Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
Employee Assistance Program providing free and confidential counselling and support.
CatholicCare Day - an additional paid leave day at the end of the year.
Flexible work arrangements.
A supportive, respectful and inclusive workplace.
Opportunities to grow your career within a growing CatholicCare service.

Ready for Your Next Opportunity?

If you’re looking for a leadership role where you can use your specialist knowledge, develop a team and help shape a growing service, we’d love to hear from you.

Bring your expertise in homelessness and mental health and join CatholicCare as we continue to grow our impact in the community.

Submit your Cover Letter and Resume outlining how your experience aligns with this role. For more information about Dom's place visit: https://catholiccaredbb.org.au/individual-family-supports/doms-place

Should you have any questions before applying, please contact recruitment@catholiccaredbb.org.au

CatholicCare is a safe, respectful and inclusive employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and can provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

Job Description

Responsible for building business success through proactive lifecycle management, product development, and expansion of the assigned Portfolio responsibility. This role acts as the central interface for developing and executing global portfolio strategies in close collaboration with colleagues in R&D, Sales, Strategy, and Marketing.
At Client, we know the stakes are high for cell and gene therapy developers, and time-to-market is critical. That's why greater process efficiency, solid regulatory expertise, and having future scale-up in mind are vital. To maximize our customers chance of success, we've crafted a series of GMP solutions for cell and gene therapy based on these core principles. Using Thera PEAK� Products customers can better plan the development of their therapy, from discovery right through to commercialization. (Depending on team structure, this role may report to a Senior or Associate Director product manager).

Main Responsibilities:

Product Line Strategy

Ensure Bioscience continues to strive to be a leader in its segment with new product and service offerings that meet unmet market needs and are differentiated from the competition.
Manage the complete life cycle and value chain of the assigned product portfolio within (market, competition, customer, and application intelligence) in close cooperation with the marketing manager and strategy teams to deliver on customer commitments as well as on sales and profit targets.
Drive the innovation strategy for the portfolio assigned, execute required customer intelligence, and provide leadership for new product development programs. Includes responsibility for business case development and formalization through the stage gate process, development of product specifications and use cases, beta testing programs, and preparing products for launch.
Understand customer needs and the opportunities for BioScience as part of the workflow needs. Develop a key understanding of customers' existing needs and unmet needs and map them to our current and future offerings through market and customer insight studies. Own and manage the product pricing strategy.
Actively identify new areas for customer and business value, including improved products and services, improved margins, and new technology and IP offerings.
Work closely with relevant stakeholders in the business, such as sales and marketing management, to develop and implement pricing, positioning, and channel strategies for the various global regions and market segments.

Sales and Operations Planning and Performance Insights:

Drive the forecasting process to provide a vital link between sales forecasts and production quantities to address demand exceptions, forecast new products, inventory management, and assist with prioritization in the event of supply challenges.
Monitor the performance of the product portfolio to ensure revenue, volume, and margin targets are consistently met and escalate concerns and required adjustments.
Monitor product line performance at the customer level to understand trends and identify new challenges and opportunities to inform the business strategy and go-to-market activities.
Provide regular reports as requested by business leadership.
Understand the assigned portfolio at all levels and keep key stakeholder groups (Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Finance) apprised at all times of new developments and opportunities.

Marketing Planning:

Actively support the development of comprehensive Marketing plans for the assigned portfolio by collaborating closely with the marketing management team.
Support the marketing team in global campaigns to drive sales for the portfolio assigned.
Support the generation of marketing and PR content by the marketing team to position the products assigned.

Product Sales & Support:

Generate technical awareness in the appropriate departments to handle routine customer concerns quickly.
Respond directly to non-routine technical, business questions, and regulatory questions.
Support the sales and service teams through customer visits and regular communication, including participation in regional and global sales meetings.
Actively drive training of service and sales representatives to sell and support the product portfolio on technical and regulatory aspects.

Safety/Compliance:

Manage the safety, FDA, ISO 9001:2015, and other regulatory requirements of the associated production sites and legal entities.
Join Deviation Review Board Meetings.
Support Change Control and Corrective and Preventive Actions driven by Quality.
Work with sales and marketing for customer communication and positioning.

Requirements:

Bachelor's Degree (Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry or equivalent).
Entry Level - 0-4 years, Life Science Biotech CDMO Product Management Technical Support/R&D or equivalent Marketing Portfolio Strategy.

Critical to this is:

Product Line Strategy: Lifecycle management, innovation strategy and process, and pricing.
Sales and Operations Planning and Performance Insights: Product forecasting and inventory management, portfolio and customer performance, and deep portfolio understanding.
Marketing planning: Support the development of the marketing strategy and provide technical input.
Product Sales & Support: Drive technical awareness in supporting teams and provide second-line non-routine technical, business, and regulatory support coordination.
Safety/Compliance: Manage the safety and regulatory requirements of the assigned portfolio, supporting CAPA and change control commercial activities.

Deal Desk Program Manager – Position Summary

As a Deal Desk Program Manager in our Solutions Services Group, you will play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and governance across the Services Solutions Deal Desk function. This position is responsible for managing Change Request (CR) governance arising from customer requirements, solution scope modifications, and contractual changes, ensuring effective intake management, stakeholder alignment, impact assessment, and routing through appropriate approval paths in accordance with established governance frameworks and SSG Delegation of Authority (DOA). The role is also responsible for leading the Deal Desk Business Management System (BMS), including strategic projects, reporting and visualization, compliance monitoring, process improvements, and cross-functional initiatives that enable efficient deal execution, governance adherence, and operational success of the team. The ideal candidate combines strong program management, business acumen, governance expertise, and stakeholder management skills to drive scalable, compliant, and efficient business operations.

Responsibilities

Program Governance Execution

Manage the intake, assessment, tracking, and governance of Change Requests (CRs) arising from solution scope modifications, customer requirements, and contractual changes, ensuring requests are routed through the appropriate approval and governance paths in accordance with SSG Delegation of Authority (DOA) and established governance frameworks.

Coordinate the design, rollout, and continuous improvement of Deal Desk programs, frameworks, and operating models across geographies and service lines.

Drive alignment between Sales, Commercial, Finance, Legal, and Delivery teams to ensure standardized, scalable deal governance processes.

Establish program BMS, KPI reporting and dashboards, deliver insights and manage cadence to support Deal Desk efficiency, throughput, and impact.

Provide regular recommendations based on data driven insights, and collaborate with key stakeholders to realize proposed solutions and efficiencies.

Execute a regular audit program to monitor compliance across the deal flow, driving improvement in overall compliance and recovery plans where required.

Process Optimization Enablement

Identify bottlenecks in the deal lifecycle and implement automation, playbooks, or tools.

Partner with enablement and operations teams to embed new processes, policies, and tools.

Manage change initiatives and ensure adoption of Deal Desk standards and best practices globally.

Stakeholder Engagement Communication

Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales and Leadership on deal governance, change management, and process design.

Communicate program goals, status, and outcomes across regions and functions, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Champion cross-functional collaboration to ensure a seamless deal experience for stakeholders and clients.

Qualifications

Bachelors Degree in business, finance or a related field. MBA or equivalent is a plus.

Proven experience in Deal Desk, sales operations, program management, contract governance, change management, or related roles within a services organization.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make data driven recommendations.

Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power BI and Codata.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel).

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.

Attention to detail, strong organizational skills and ability to work in a fast paced environment.

Ability to work as part of a global team which may require engaging across distances, cultures, and time zones in a matrix organizational structure.

Ability to balance commercial agility with governance rigor.

3-8 years of progressive broad-based program management, information technology and business experience.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

IT Security Analyst

Location: Victoria, London

About my client.

My client is a leading commodities trading and investment firm with offices in London, New York, Singapore, Melbourne and Puerto Rico. We operate across 50 countries on six continents, trading more than 20 different commodities including energy, metals, dry bulk, ocean freight and renewable technologies.

Their objective is to provide certainty and stability for their clients in an increasingly volatile sector, assisting them with financing, logistics and green solutions. Their success stems from a strategy of promoting deep, long-term relationships all along the commodity supply chain.

Established in 2015, my client employs 250 people, deploying a balance sheet exceeding $1.5bn. They are 100% owned by management, which allows them the flexibility to make investment decisions that secure the longevity and prosperity of the company.

The firm is a unique place to grow your career. They take pride in their values, global reach, meritocratic culture and strong work ethic. their success over the years has been built on their guiding principles of customer service, creativity, transparency, integrity, and responsibility.

Whilst their footprint grows, they still foster a small-company atmosphere. They have a flat company structure and encourage collaboration across all seniority levels, teams and locations to generate the best ideas. They are committed to the wellbeing of their colleagues and organise various social evenings, sports clubs and lunchtime activities.

About The Role:

This position will work on security risk mitigation activities with a strong focus on incident response, vulnerability management and threat intelligence, as well as support the design and implementation of coherent and robust security solutions.
You will be working within the IT Infrastructure team to support the day to day running of the business from an IT security standpoint. Ensuring security standards are embedded into all operational processes. Acting as a go to person for staff with IT security related queries.
Working within the Infrastructure Team to create and support cyber security incident response plans. Supporting the creation and maintenance of IT security policies and procedures.
Work with the wider IT Support team to ensure accuracy of asset inventory and timely delivery of product updates to end user devices.
Promoting organisational awareness of information security, through regular updates.
You will be involved with regular Pen Tests, Endpoint Protection patching and vulnerability management, along with working with external SOC teams to investigate issues.
Reviewing current security controls and identifying new processes and controls to help keep the business safe.

Skills and Experience Required

Minimum 3 years hands on Information security monitoring and response or related experience
Able to demonstrate experience in information security or performing information security duties as part of another role.
Knowledge or Experience with EDR, SIEM, NDR, Vulnerability management, MITRE attack framework, Cyber Essentials and Incident response. (Desirable)
Ability to work independently on resolving issues and working as a team.
Understanding of network architecture and tools such as Cisco firewalls, switches, Cisco Umbrella, Wireshark and internet connectivity.
Ability to create and maintain accurate, timely, and comprehensive documentation of security related processes and systems.
Understanding or experience of running information security awareness campaigns.
Having an understanding of threats in the financial services sector.
Keep up to date with the latest cyber security trends and the threat landscape.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

The Data Center Infrastructure Delivery team at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
is a dynamic group of professionals dedicated to delivering state-of-the-art data center facilities at scale and at pace. This team comprises experienced project managers who work collaboratively with vendors and internal teams to ensure the successful execution of complex data center construction and network projects. They bring a wealth of expertise in project management, technical design, and on-site construction, ensuring that our data centers meet the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and sustainability. This team plays a crucial role in supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's data needs and driving our growth and success.

Job Summary

Strategically, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive plans that optimize efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and operational excellence in delivery. You will engage with key stakeholders, manage high-stakes vendor relationships, and navigate the complexities of regulatory compliance. Your ability to anticipate and mitigate risks to datacenter delivery will be crucial in maintaining project timelines and budgets.
This is a high-impact role that will lead, drive, and ensure the successful management and delivery of critical initiatives on our strategic roadmap. The role comes with a high degree of personal accountability and autonomy and will require effective engagement across Design, Engineering and Operations.

Your ability to anticipate and mitigate risks will be crucial in maintaining project timelines and budgets. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to own end-to-end delivery of network and data center capacity across concurrent builds.
This role will oversee data center focused projects and initiatives. Managing these construction projects well is key to the overall success of customer deliveries. You will engage directly with our Colo and LV partners’ leadership and project management teams, driving accountability and improvements to meet our customers’ needs.

You will also engage with internal teams to make sure we deliver the proper design and process documentation to the Colo, execute on our ISP circuit contracts, and update all internal tracking tools for handover to our operations teams at the end of the project.

Key Responsibilities Include:

• Being the end-to-end leader in charge of the program, from shaping the approach to achieving the desired outcomes through delivery.
• Project Planning:
Develop and implement long-term strategies for data center construction and network build projects to align with organizational goals.
• Partner with the design team to ensure design and construction are fully coordinated in advance of contracting.
• Partner with Construction team to ensure collaboration and seem less handoff.
• Project Management:
Oversee all phases of complex data center construction projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
• Tenant Fit Out and LV Integration: Work closely throughout design, construction, commissioning and LV fit out to fully coordinate and integrate the separate scopes of tenant fit out projects with the overall project scope.
• Vendor Management:
Select, negotiate, and manage external vendors, contractors, and suppliers to ensure project success.
• Budget Oversight:
Develop and manage project budgets, ensuring cost-effective use of resources and adherence to financial constraints.
• Risk Management:
Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project timelines and costs.
• Stakeholder Communication:
Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and addressing any concerns.
• Quality Assurance:
Implement and oversee quality control processes to ensure the highest standards of construction and operational efficiency.
• Regular project visits to ensure schedule, coordination, and quality will be required throughout the life of the project on an as needed basis.

Required Skills

At least 5 years of Project management experience in delivery mission critical Data Centre Construction, Cabling, Compute, Networking, AI infrastructure project.

At least 5 years of Program/Portfolio management experience.

PMP/ITIL v3 or equivalent certification

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex challenges in a fast-paced construction environment.
• Strategic Planning:
Expertise in developing and implementing long-term strategies and establishing program-level requirements for construction projects.
• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of data center design, construction, and operational requirements, with a focus on cutting-edge technologies and sustainability.

• Project Management:
Proven expertise in managing large-scale data center construction projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely and within-budget delivery including advanced project scheduling and tracking.

Help
